objects.name: Phishing Abuses RMM Tools for Persistent Access
objects.description: Microsoft observed unattributed phishing campaigns in July 2026 targeting organizations across multiple industries with deceptively named, legitimate MSP360 RMM installers. Successful installations established persistent remote access and used PowerShell to install ConnectWise ScreenConnect as a second access channel. Attackers then transferred and executed additional utilities supporting information collection and credential-access activity.
